GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical Families ● Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, halogens, noble gases  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
